title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: freight terms, issuance fee and issuance standards by document type
content:
## Scope

For Bills of Lading and Transport Documents, this card gives the issuance-related values of each document type: whether a booking with collect freight may be documented on it, the issuance fee per set, whether it may be issued on a received-for-shipment basis, the issuance service standard after departure, and the prepaid-freight settlement setting with its credit-customer exemption.

## Tier table

| Document type | Collect freight may be documented | Issuance fee per set | Received-for-shipment issuance (once gated in, before loading) | Issued within this many hours after departure (service standard) | Prepaid freight must be settled before issuance | Credit-approved customer exempt from that settlement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Sea Waybill | Yes | USD 45.00 | No | 24 | No | Yes |
| AHL Electronic Bill of Lading | Yes | USD 35.00 | No | 4 | No | Yes |
| AHL Straight Bill of Lading | Yes | USD 65.00 | No | 24 | Yes | Yes |
| AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading | Yes | USD 75.00 | No | 24 | Yes | Yes |
| AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading | Yes | USD 95.00 | Yes | 48 | Yes | Yes |
| AHL Switch Bill of Lading | No | USD 75.00 | No | 72 | Yes | No |

## Reading the table by column

- The issuance fee is a fee per set issued, in USD.
- The hours after departure are a service standard of the line, not an eligibility condition for the customer.
- The credit-customer column matters only on a tier whose prepaid-settlement setting is Yes.

## Points of judgement

**On which types does the prepaid settlement setting apply at all?** On the AHL Straight, AHL Negotiable, AHL Combined Transport and AHL Switch Bills of Lading. On the AHL Sea Waybill and the AHL Electronic Bill of Lading the setting is No.

**Is there a type on which a credit-approved customer gains no exemption?** Yes, the AHL Switch Bill of Lading, whose exemption setting is No.

**Which type may be issued once the cargo is gated in, before loading?** Only the AHL Combined Transport Bill of Lading.

**Which type cannot document collect freight?** Only the AHL Switch Bill of Lading.
